CustomField.description: Marks Contact 1 of this row as the household's primary member (the head of household) for Nonprofit Cloud Household conversion. Set it on the main submission when Contact 1 is the head, or on a related row (a repeater row for the parent when the applicant is a child). The base package never writes household memberships, so the field is inert here; the Nonprofit Cloud extension's Household engine reads it: the membership written for a flagged row takes the primary seat and the previous primary member of that Household is demoted, so a Household always has exactly one. When no row is flagged, the first person added to the Household stays its primary member. Map it in Form Builder like any staging field (a "Head of household?" question), set it from a Prefill Template, or carry it on the repeater row form.
CustomField.label: Primary Contact
